dedupe_keys.name: chek 3d city model data requirements profiles and sample data v1 0

description: The CHEK project publishes OGC Building Block validation profiles and sample 3D-city data for CityGML and CityJSON. The Zenodo software deposit is open under Apache 2.0 and links a public versioned repository. The described profiles cover Ascoli Piceno, Lisbon, Vila Nova de Gaia and Prague; samples are stated for the first two cities. These rulesets can check city-model input structure before building-exposure or energy simulation and help transfer attributes between municipal 3D models. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this version 1.0 profile and sample bundle. It is classified here as a data standard and sample source, not as a simulation engine. A limitation is that profile conformance does not prove geometric accuracy, up-to-date buildings or compatibility with every downstream simulator. The public README states only the broad project role and does not enumerate every field or example geometry. The archive was not downloaded, and no sample was validated.
